const template_009 =
  "import { useEffect } from 'preact/hooks';\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Zero-UI island: delegated copy-to-clipboard for `[data-token-copy]` buttons.\r\n *\r\n * Any server-rendered element carrying `data-token-copy=\"<text>\"` becomes a\r\n * copy control; a transient `data-copied` attribute drives the confirmation\r\n * styling in `assets/design.css`.\r\n */\r\nexport default function TokenClipboard(): null {\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {\r\n      const trigger = (event.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest<HTMLElement>(\r\n        '[data-token-copy]',\r\n      );\r\n      const text = trigger?.dataset.tokenCopy;\r\n      if (!trigger || !text) return;\r\n      void navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {\r\n        trigger.setAttribute('data-copied', 'true');\r\n        setTimeout(() => trigger.removeAttribute('data-copied'), 1200);\r\n      });\r\n    };\r\n    document.addEventListener('click', onClick);\r\n    return () => document.removeEventListener('click', onClick);\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  return null;\r\n}\r\n";

  "import manifest from '@app/assets/tokens.json' with { type: 'json' };\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * One entry from the generated design-token manifest (`assets/tokens.json`).\r\n */\r\nexport interface DesignToken {\r\n  readonly name: string;\r\n  readonly type: string;\r\n  readonly value: string;\r\n  readonly cssVar: string;\r\n  readonly path: readonly string[];\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** A primitive color ramp (gray, copper, ...) in ascending step order. */\r\nexport interface ColorRamp {\r\n  readonly name: string;\r\n  readonly steps: readonly DesignToken[];\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** A semantic intent (primary, success, ...) with its companion tokens. */\r\nexport interface SemanticIntent {\r\n  readonly role: string;\r\n  readonly tokens: readonly DesignToken[];\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst RAMP_ORDER = ['gray', 'copper', 'teal', 'slate', 'red', 'amber'] as const;\r\n\r\nconst INTENT_ORDER = [\r\n  'primary',\r\n  'secondary',\r\n  'accent',\r\n  'success',\r\n  'warning',\r\n  'destructive',\r\n] as const;\r\n\r\nconst FOUNDATION_ORDER = [\r\n  'bg',\r\n  'fg',\r\n  'surface',\r\n  'surface-raised',\r\n  'overlay',\r\n  'card',\r\n  'card-fg',\r\n  'muted',\r\n  'muted-fg',\r\n  'border',\r\n  'border-hover',\r\n  'border-strong',\r\n  'input-border',\r\n  'ring',\r\n] as const;\r\n\r\nconst allTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = Object.entries(manifest.tokens).map(\r\n  ([name, token]) => ({\r\n    name,\r\n    type: token.type,\r\n    value: String(token.value),\r\n    cssVar: token.cssVar,\r\n    path: token.path,\r\n  }),\r\n);\r\n\r\nfunction tokensIn(group: string): DesignToken[] {\r\n  return allTokens.filter((token) => token.path[0] === group);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Sorts spacing tokens by their resolved pixel size. */\r\nfunction spaceSize(token: DesignToken): number {\r\n  if (token.value.endsWith('px')) return Number.parseFloat(token.value);\r\n  return Number.parseFloat(token.value) * 16;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Manifest metadata for the page header. */\r\nexport const tokenManifestMeta = {\r\n  version: manifest.version,\r\n  generatedBy: manifest.generatedBy,\r\n  total: allTokens.length,\r\n} as const;\r\n\r\n/** Primitive color ramps in display order. */\r\nexport const colorRamps: readonly ColorRamp[] = RAMP_ORDER.map((name) => ({\r\n  name,\r\n  steps: tokensIn('color').filter((token) => token.path[1] === name),\r\n}));\r\n\r\n/** Theme-independent semantic foundation tokens (surfaces, text, borders). */\r\nexport const foundationTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = FOUNDATION_ORDER.map(\r\n  (name) => tokensIn('semantic').find((token) => token.name === name),\r\n).filter((token): token is DesignToken => token !== undefined);\r\n\r\n/** Semantic intents with their full companion sets (base, fg, hover, subtle, border). */\r\nexport const semanticIntents: readonly SemanticIntent[] = INTENT_ORDER.map((role) => ({\r\n  role,\r\n  tokens: tokensIn('semantic').filter(\r\n    (token) => token.name === role || token.name.startsWith(`${role}-`),\r\n  ),\r\n}));\r\n\r\n/** Font family tokens. */\r\nexport const fontTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('font');\r\n\r\n/** Type scale tokens in ascending size order. */\r\nexport const textTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('text');\r\n\r\n/** Line-height tokens. */\r\nexport const leadingTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('leading');\r\n\r\n/** Letter-spacing tokens. */\r\nexport const trackingTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('tracking');\r\n\r\n/** Spacing scale sorted by resolved size. */\r\nexport const spaceTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = [...tokensIn('space')].sort(\r\n  (a, b) => spaceSize(a) - spaceSize(b),\r\n);\r\n\r\n/** Corner radius tokens. */\r\nexport const radiusTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('radius');\r\n\r\n/** Elevation (box-shadow) tokens. */\r\nexport const shadowTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('shadow');\r\n\r\n/** Motion (duration + easing) tokens. */\r\nexport const easeTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = tokensIn('ease');\r\n\r\n/** Z-index scale tokens in stacking order. */\r\nexport const zTokens: readonly DesignToken[] = [...tokensIn('z')].sort(\r\n  (a, b) => Number.parseFloat(a.value) - Number.parseFloat(b.value),\r\n);\r\n";

const template_014 =
  "import { appRoutes } from '@app/router.ts';\r\n\r\n/** How a top-bar link decides that it marks the current page. */\r\nexport type NavigationMatch = 'exact' | 'prefix';\r\n\r\n/** One top-bar link rendered by `routes/_layout.tsx`. */\r\nexport interface NavigationItem {\r\n  /** Typed href from `appRoutes`. */\r\n  readonly href: string;\r\n  /** Visible link text. */\r\n  readonly label: string;\r\n  /** `prefix` keeps the link current on nested pages such as `/examples/crud`. */\r\n  readonly match: NavigationMatch;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Top-bar links, in display order. Every page renders inside the app chrome; list a page here to\r\n * link it. `netscript ui:add page <path>` appends top-level pages for you.\r\n */\r\nexport const appNavigation: readonly NavigationItem[] = [\r\n  { href: appRoutes.home.href(), label: 'Home', match: 'exact' },\r\n  { href: appRoutes.dashboard.href(), label: 'Dashboard', match: 'exact' },\r\n  { href: appRoutes.examples.href(), label: 'Examples', match: 'prefix' },\r\n  { href: appRoutes.health.href(), label: 'Health', match: 'exact' },\r\n  { href: appRoutes.design.href(), label: 'Design', match: 'prefix' },\r\n];\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Route prefixes whose pages render their own chrome instead of the app top bar. `/design` ships\r\n * its own sidebar shell; add a prefix for a full-screen page such as a sign-in screen.\r\n */\r\nexport const chromelessRoutePrefixes: readonly string[] = [appRoutes.design.href()];\r\n\r\nfunction isUnderPrefix(pathname: string, prefix: string): boolean {\r\n  return pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Whether `item` links to the page at `pathname`. */\r\nexport function isCurrentNavigation(item: NavigationItem, pathname: string): boolean {\r\n  return item.match === 'exact' ? pathname === item.href : isUnderPrefix(pathname, item.href);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Whether the page at `pathname` renders inside the app top bar. */\r\nexport function rendersAppChrome(pathname: string): boolean {\r\n  return !chromelessRoutePrefixes.some((prefix) => isUnderPrefix(pathname, prefix));\r\n}\r\n";

Fire a webhook to generate\r\n              a cross-service trace chain (trigger &rarr; queue &rarr; worker &rarr; job), then\r\n              refresh to see spans appear below.\r\n            </p>\r\n          </div>\r\n\r\n          <div class='flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4'>\r\n            <form method='POST'>\r\n              <Button type='submit' variant='primary' size='sm'>\r\n                Fire webhook trace\r\n              </Button>\r\n            </form>\r\n            {data.dashboardUrl && (\r\n              <Button type='link' href={data.dashboardUrl} variant='outline' size='sm'>\r\n                Open Dashboard\r\n              </Button>\r\n            )}\r\n            <span class='text-xs text-ns-muted-fg'>\r\n              {data.totalSpans} total spans &middot; {data.traces.length} traces shown\r\n            </span>\r\n          </div>\r\n\r\n          {data.error && (\r\n            <div class='rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-400'>\r\n              Dashboard API error: {data.error}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )}\r\n\r\n          {data.traces.length === 0 && !data.error && (\r\n            <div class='rounded-lg border border-ns-border bg-ns-surface/60 px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-ns-muted-fg'>\r\n              No traces captured yet. const template_037 =
  "import { getServiceUrl } from '@netscript/sdk';\r\nimport { AspirePsDashboardReader, resolveTelemetryEndpoint } from '@netscript/mcp';\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n// Types\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\nexport interface TelemetrySpan {\r\n  readonly traceId: string;\r\n  readonly spanId: string;\r\n  readonly parentSpanId: string;\r\n  readonly name: string;\r\n  readonly service: string;\r\n  readonly kind: number;\r\n  readonly durationMs: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport interface TelemetryTrace {\r\n  readonly traceId: string;\r\n  readonly services: readonly string[];\r\n  readonly spans: readonly TelemetrySpan[];\r\n  readonly isCrossService: boolean;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport interface TelemetryTraceData {\r\n  readonly traces: readonly TelemetryTrace[];\r\n  readonly totalSpans: number;\r\n  readonly dashboardUrl?: string;\r\n  readonly error?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport interface WebhookFireResult {\r\n  readonly ok: boolean;\r\n  readonly status?: number;\r\n  readonly error?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n// Dashboard API helpers\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\ninterface OtlpSpan {\r\n  name: string;\r\n  kind: number;\r\n  traceId: string;\r\n  spanId: string;\r\n  parentSpanId: string;\r\n  startTimeUnixNano: string;\r\n  endTimeUnixNano: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface OtlpScopeSpans {\r\n  spans: OtlpSpan[];\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface OtlpResource {\r\n  attributes: { key: string; value: { stringValue?: string } }[];\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface OtlpResourceSpans {\r\n  scopeSpans: OtlpScopeSpans[];\r\n  resource: OtlpResource;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface DashboardTraceResponse {\r\n  data: { resourceSpans: OtlpResourceSpans[] };\r\n  totalCount: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE = 'dashboard unavailable — run `aspire ps`';\r\n\r\nfunction getDashboardBaseUrl(): string | undefined {\r\n  const resolved = resolveTelemetryEndpoint(undefined, {\r\n    NETSCRIPT_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT: Deno.env.get('NETSCRIPT_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT'),\r\n    ASPIRE_DASHBOARD_PORT: Deno.env.get('ASPIRE_DASHBOARD_PORT'),\r\n  }, new AspirePsDashboardReader());\r\n  return resolved.source === 'default'\r\n    ? undefined\r\n    : resolved.httpsFallback ?? resolved.endpoint;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction getServiceName(resource: OtlpResource): string {\r\n  return (\r\n    resource.attributes.find((a) => a.key === 'service.name')?.value\r\n      .stringValue ?? 'unknown'\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction nanoDuration(start: string, end: string): number {\r\n  return Math.round((Number(BigInt(end) - BigInt(start)) / 1_000_000));\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function fetchDashboardTraces(): Promise<TelemetryTraceData> {\r\n  const baseUrl = getDashboardBaseUrl();\r\n  if (!baseUrl) {\r\n    return { traces: [], totalSpans: 0, error: DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE };\r\n  }\r\n  const url = `${baseUrl}/api/telemetry/traces`;\r\n\r\n  try {\r\n    const resp = await fetch(url, {\r\n      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },\r\n    });\r\n    if (!resp.ok) {\r\n      return { traces: [], totalSpans: 0, dashboardUrl: baseUrl, error: `Dashboard API ${resp.status}` };\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const body = (await resp.json()) as DashboardTraceResponse;\r\n    const rs = body.data.resourceSpans;\r\n\r\n    const allSpans: TelemetrySpan[] = [];\r\n    for (const r of rs) {\r\n      const svc = getServiceName(r.resource);\r\n      for (const ss of r.scopeSpans) {\r\n        for (const span of ss.spans) {\r\n          allSpans.push({\r\n            traceId: span.traceId,\r\n            spanId: span.spanId,\r\n            parentSpanId: span.parentSpanId,\r\n            name: span.name,\r\n            service: svc,\r\n            kind: span.kind,\r\n            durationMs: nanoDuration(span.startTimeUnixNano, span.endTimeUnixNano),\r\n          });\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const byTrace = new Map<string, TelemetrySpan[]>();\r\n    for (const s of allSpans) {\r\n      const arr = byTrace.get(s.traceId) ?? [];\r\n      arr.push(s);\r\n      byTrace.set(s.traceId, arr);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const traces: TelemetryTrace[] = [...byTrace.entries()]\r\n      .map(([traceId, spans]) => {\r\n        const services = [...new Set(spans.map((s) => s.service))];\r\n        return {\r\n          traceId,\r\n          services,\r\n          spans,\r\n          isCrossService: services.length > 1,\r\n        };\r\n      })\r\n      .sort((a, b) => b.spans.length - a.spans.length)\r\n      .slice(0, 20);\r\n\r\n    return { traces, totalSpans: allSpans.length, dashboardUrl: baseUrl };\r\n  } catch (err) {\r\n    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);\r\n    return { traces: [], totalSpans: 0, dashboardUrl: baseUrl, error: msg };\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n// Webhook trigger\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\nexport async function fireWebhookTrace(): Promise<WebhookFireResult> {\r\n  try {\r\n    const triggersUrl = getServiceUrl('triggers-api', 'http');\r\n    const webhookUrl = `${triggersUrl}/api/v1/webhooks/inbound/generic`;\r\n    const resp = await fetch(webhookUrl, {\r\n      method: 'POST',\r\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\r\n      body: JSON.stringify({\r\n        message: 'telemetry-page-trace',\r\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\r\n      }),\r\n    });\r\n    return { ok: resp.ok, status: resp.status };\r\n  } catch (err) {\r\n    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n";

ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT: 'ASPIRE_ALLOW_UNSECURED_TRANSPORT',\r\n  UNSECURED_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS: 'ASPIRE_DASHBOARD_UNSECURED_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS',\r\n} as const;\r\n\r\nexport const DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS: readonly string[] = [\r\n  '--allow-net',\r\n  '--allow-env',\r\n  '--allow-read',\r\n  '--allow-sys',\r\n] as const;\r\n\r\nexport const RESOURCE_DEFAULTS = {\r\n  DbCliModeExcludeFromMcp: true,\r\n  Runtime: 'deno',\r\n  ServiceEntrypoint: 'src/main.ts',\r\n  AppEntrypoint: 'main.ts',\r\n  WatchHmrFlag: '--watch-hmr',\r\n  WatchFlag: '--watch',\r\n  NodeModulesDirNoneFlag: '--node-modules-dir=none',\r\n  UnstableWorkerOptionsFlag: '--unstable-worker-options',\r\n  PortEnvVar: 'PORT',\r\n  HttpEndpointName: 'http',\r\n} as const;\r\n\r\nconst GARNET_TOOL_RESTORE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;\r\nconst LISTENER_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;\r\nconst ENDPOINT_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT = 'ENDPOINT_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT';\r\nconst RESP_PING_COMMAND = '*1\\r\\n$4\\r\\nPING\\r\\n';\r\nconst RESP_REPLY_LIMIT_BYTES = 256;\r\nconst RESP_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT_BYTES = 64;\r\n// Bare specifier kept out of the static graph: only AppHosts with a container PostgreSQL\r\n// database declare `pg` in package.json, and only their health checks ever load it.\r\nconst POSTGRES_CLIENT_MODULE = 'pg';\r\nconst POSTGRES_DEFAULT_USER = 'postgres';\r\nconst POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;\r\nconst POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT = 'POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT';\r\nconst POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_QUERY = 'SELECT 1';\r\nconst POSTGRES_SQLSTATES: Readonly<Record<string, Omit<PostgresCredentialFailure, 'code'>>> = {\r\n  '28P01': { failureClass: 'auth', name: 'invalid_password' },\r\n  '28000': { failureClass: 'auth', name: 'invalid_authorization_specification' },\r\n  '3D000': { failureClass: 'database', name: 'invalid_catalog_name' },\r\n  '57P03': { failureClass: 'starting', name: 'cannot_connect_now' },\r\n  '53300': { failureClass: 'server', name: 'too_many_connections' },\r\n};\r\n\r\nlet postgresClientConstructor: Promise<PostgresClientConstructor> | undefined;\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Listener readiness\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\n/** Creates a listener check whose Aspire endpoint allocation has a total deadline. */\r\nexport function createEndpointListenerReadinessCheck(\r\n  options: EndpointListenerReadinessCheckOptions,\r\n): () => Promise<HealthCheckResult> {\r\n  return async () => {\r\n    const startedAt = performance.now();\r\n    let resolved: ResolvedListenerEndpoint;\r\n    try {\r\n      resolved = await resolveListenerEndpoint(options.endpoint);\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      return endpointAllocationFailure(options.kind, startedAt, error);\r\n    }\r\n    return await createListenerReadinessCheck({\r\n      kind: options.kind,\r\n      host: resolved.host,\r\n      port: resolved.port,\r\n    })();\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Creates a one-socket TCP listener readiness check for an Aspire resource. */\r\nexport function createListenerReadinessCheck(\r\n  options: ListenerReadinessCheckOptions,\r\n): () => Promise<HealthCheckResult> {\r\n  return () =>\r\n    new Promise((resolve) => {\r\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\r\n      const port = normalizeListenerPort(options.port);\r\n      const socket = createConnection({ host: options.host, port });\r\n      let settled = false;\r\n\r\n      const finish = (result: HealthCheckResult): void => {\r\n        if (settled) return;\r\n        settled = true;\r\n        socket.destroy();\r\n        resolve(result);\r\n      };\r\n\r\n      socket.setTimeout(LISTENER_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS);\r\n      socket.once('connect', () => {\r\n        finish({\r\n          status: HealthStatus.Healthy,\r\n          description: `${options.kind} listener ready on ${options.host}:${port}`,\r\n        });\r\n      });\r\n      socket.once('error', (error) => {\r\n        finish(\r\n          listenerFailure(options.kind, options.host, port, socketErrorCode(error), startedAt),\r\n        );\r\n      });\r\n      socket.once('timeout', () => {\r\n        finish(listenerFailure(options.kind, options.host, port, 'ETIMEDOUT', startedAt));\r\n      });\r\n    });\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Creates one bounded RESP2 PING observation for an Aspire health evaluation. */\r\nexport function createRespPingCheck(\r\n  options: RespPingCheckOptions,\r\n): () => Promise<HealthCheckResult> {\r\n  return () =>\r\n    new Promise((resolve) => {\r\n      const startedAt = performance.now();\r\n      const port = normalizeListenerPort(options.port);\r\n      const socket = createConnection({ host: options.host, port });\r\n      let settled = false;\r\n      let received: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> = new Uint8Array();\r\n\r\n      const finish = (result: HealthCheckResult): void => {\r\n        if (settled) return;\r\n        settled = true;\r\n        socket.destroy();\r\n        resolve(result);\r\n      };\r\n\r\n      socket.setTimeout(LISTENER_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS);\r\n      socket.once('connect', () => {\r\n        socket.write(RESP_PING_COMMAND);\r\n      });\r\n      socket.on('data', (data) => {\r\n        received = appendRespBytes(received, data);\r\n        if (received.length > RESP_REPLY_LIMIT_BYTES) {\r\n          finish(respFailure(options.host, port, 'EPROTO', startedAt, received));\r\n          return;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        const terminator = findCrlf(received);\r\n        if (terminator < 0) return;\r\n        const reply = new TextDecoder().decode(received.subarray(0, terminator));\r\n        if (reply === '+PONG') {\r\n          finish({\r\n            status: HealthStatus.Healthy,\r\n            description: `RESP listener ready on ${options.host}:${port}`,\r\n          });\r\n          return;\r\n        }\r\n        if (reply.startsWith('-NOAUTH')) {\r\n          finish(respFailure(options.host, port, 'NOAUTH', startedAt, received));\r\n          return;\r\n        }\r\n        finish(respFailure(options.host, port, 'EPROTO', startedAt, received));\r\n      });\r\n      socket.once('end', () => {\r\n        finish(respFailure(options.host, port, 'EPROTO', startedAt, received));\r\n      });\r\n      socket.once('error', (error) => {\r\n        finish(respFailure(options.host, port, socketErrorCode(error), startedAt, received));\r\n      });\r\n      socket.once('timeout', () => {\r\n        finish(respFailure(options.host, port, 'ETIMEDOUT', startedAt, received));\r\n      });\r\n    });\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// PostgreSQL credential readiness\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Creates a bounded credential check: one authenticated `SELECT 1` against the server's\r\n * published endpoint. A listener can accept the socket while the server still rejects the\r\n * login, so this check — not the listener check — decides whether consumers can connect.\r\n * The result is classified from SQLSTATE and socket codes only: the password, the role and\r\n * any server- or driver-supplied text never reach `healthReports`.\r\n */\r\nexport function createPostgresCredentialReadinessCheck(\r\n  options: PostgresCredentialReadinessCheckOptions,\r\n): () => Promise<HealthCheckResult> {\r\n  return async () => {\r\n    const startedAt = performance.now();\r\n    let target: ResolvedListenerEndpoint;\r\n    try {\r\n      target = await resolveListenerEndpoint(options.endpoint);\r\n    } catch {\r\n      return postgresCredentialFailure(\r\n        { failureClass: 'listener', code: 'ENDPOINT_UNALLOCATED' },\r\n        undefined,\r\n        startedAt,\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n    const port = normalizeListenerPort(target.port);\r\n    let Client: PostgresClientConstructor;\r\n    try {\r\n      Client = await loadPostgresClient();\r\n    } catch {\r\n      return postgresCredentialFailure(\r\n        { failureClass: 'client', code: 'PG_CLIENT_UNAVAILABLE' },\r\n        { host: target.host, port },\r\n        startedAt,\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n    return await probePostgresCredentials(Client, { host: target.host, port }, options, startedAt);\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nasync function probePostgresCredentials(\r\n  Client: PostgresClientConstructor,\r\n  target: Readonly<{ host: string; port: number }>,\r\n  options: PostgresCredentialReadinessCheckOptions,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n): Promise<HealthCheckResult> {\r\n  const client = new Client({\r\n    host: target.host,\r\n    port: target.port,\r\n    user: options.user ?? POSTGRES_DEFAULT_USER,\r\n    password: options.password,\r\n    connectionTimeoutMillis: POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT_MS,\r\n    query_timeout: POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT_MS,\r\n  });\r\n  // A socket error after this evaluation settles must not become an unhandled AppHost crash.\r\n  client.on('error', () => undefined);\r\n  const login = client.connect().then(() => client.query(POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_QUERY));\r\n  // The race below observes the rejection; this handler keeps a login that loses the race quiet.\r\n  login.catch(() => undefined);\r\n  try {\r\n    await withTimeout(login, POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT_MS, POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT);\r\n    return {\r\n      status: HealthStatus.Healthy,\r\n      description: `postgres credentials accepted on ${target.host}:${target.port}`,\r\n    };\r\n  } catch (error) {\r\n    return postgresCredentialFailure(classifyPostgresError(error), target, startedAt);\r\n  } finally {\r\n    Promise.resolve().then(() => client.end()).catch(() => undefined);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction loadPostgresClient(): Promise<PostgresClientConstructor> {\r\n  postgresClientConstructor ??= import(POSTGRES_CLIENT_MODULE).then(postgresClientFromModule);\r\n  return postgresClientConstructor.catch((error: unknown) => {\r\n    // Do not pin a failed load: installing `pg` heals the next evaluation without a restart.\r\n    postgresClientConstructor = undefined;\r\n    throw error;\r\n  });\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction postgresClientFromModule(module: unknown): PostgresClientConstructor {\r\n  const named = isObjectRecord(module) ? module.Client : undefined;\r\n  const fallback = isObjectRecord(module) && isObjectRecord(module.default)\r\n    ? module.default.Client\r\n    : undefined;\r\n  const Client = named ?? fallback;\r\n  if (typeof Client !== 'function') {\r\n    throw new Error(`${POSTGRES_CLIENT_MODULE} does not export a Client constructor`);\r\n  }\r\n  return Client as PostgresClientConstructor;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction classifyPostgresError(error: unknown): PostgresCredentialFailure {\r\n  if (!(error instanceof Error)) return { failureClass: 'server', code: 'EPROTO' };\r\n  if (error.message === POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT) {\r\n    return { failureClass: 'timeout', code: 'ETIMEDOUT' };\r\n  }\r\n  const code = Reflect.get(error, 'code');\r\n  // node-postgres marks server ErrorResponse messages with a severity; socket errors carry none.\r\n  if (typeof Reflect.get(error, 'severity') === 'string' && typeof code === 'string') {\r\n    const known = POSTGRES_SQLSTATES[code];\r\n    if (known) return { ...known, code };\r\n    return { failureClass: code.startsWith('28') ? 'auth' : 'server', code };\r\n  }\r\n  if (typeof code === 'string') return { failureClass: 'listener', code };\r\n  // node-postgres reports its own connect/query deadlines and early closes without a code.\r\n  return /timeout/i.test(error.message)\r\n    ? { failureClass: 'timeout', code: 'ETIMEDOUT' }\r\n    : { failureClass: 'server', code: 'ECONNCLOSED' };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction postgresCredentialFailure(\r\n  failure: PostgresCredentialFailure,\r\n  target: Readonly<{ host: string; port: number }> | undefined,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n): HealthCheckResult {\r\n  const host = target?.host ?? '<unallocated>';\r\n  const port = target ? String(target.port) : '<unallocated>';\r\n  const elapsedMs = String(Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));\r\n  const reason = failure.name ? `${failure.code} (${failure.name})` : failure.code;\r\n  return {\r\n    status: HealthStatus.Unhealthy,\r\n    description:\r\n      `postgres credential check failed: ${failure.failureClass} ${reason} at ${host}:${port} after ${elapsedMs} ms`,\r\n    data: { class: failure.failureClass, code: failure.code, host, port, elapsedMs },\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {\r\n  return (typeof value === 'object' || typeof value === 'function') && value !== null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction appendRespBytes(\r\n  current: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>,\r\n  chunk: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>,\r\n): Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> {\r\n  const nextLength = Math.min(\r\n    current.length + chunk.length,\r\n    RESP_REPLY_LIMIT_BYTES + 1,\r\n  );\r\n  const combined = new Uint8Array(nextLength);\r\n  combined.set(current);\r\n  combined.set(chunk.subarray(0, nextLength - current.length), current.length);\r\n  return combined;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction findCrlf(bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>): number {\r\n  for (let index = 1; index < bytes.length; index += 1) {\r\n    if (bytes[index - 1] === 0x0d && bytes[index] === 0x0a) return index - 1;\r\n  }\r\n  return -1;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction listenerFailure(\r\n  kind: string,\r\n  host: string,\r\n  port: number,\r\n  code: string,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n): HealthCheckResult {\r\n  return {\r\n    status: HealthStatus.Unhealthy,\r\n    description: `${kind} listener unreachable: ${code}`,\r\n    data: listenerData(code, host, port, startedAt),\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction endpointAllocationFailure(\r\n  kind: string,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n  error: unknown,\r\n): HealthCheckResult {\r\n  const timedOut = error instanceof Error && error.message === ENDPOINT_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT;\r\n  const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\r\n  return {\r\n    status: HealthStatus.Unhealthy,\r\n    description: timedOut\r\n      ? `${kind} listener unreachable: endpoint not allocated within ${LISTENER_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`\r\n      : `${kind} listener unreachable: endpoint allocation failed (${detail})`,\r\n    data: {\r\n      code: 'ENDPOINT_UNALLOCATED',\r\n      host: '<unallocated>',\r\n      port: '<unallocated>',\r\n      elapsedMs: String(Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)),\r\n      detail,\r\n    },\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Resolves an Aspire endpoint's host and port under the listener deadline. */\r\nasync function resolveListenerEndpoint(\r\n  endpoint: () => PromiseLike<ListenerEndpoint>,\r\n): Promise<ResolvedListenerEndpoint> {\r\n  const resolved = Promise.resolve().then(endpoint).then(async (reference) => {\r\n    const [host, port] = await Promise.all([reference.host(), reference.port()]);\r\n    return { host, port };\r\n  });\r\n  return await withTimeout(resolved, LISTENER_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS);\r\n}\r\n\r\nasync function withTimeout<T>(\r\n  operation: Promise<T>,\r\n  timeoutMs: number,\r\n  timeoutCode: string = ENDPOINT_ALLOCATION_TIMEOUT,\r\n): Promise<T> {\r\n  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;\r\n  try {\r\n    return await Promise.race([\r\n      operation,\r\n      new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {\r\n        timer = setTimeout(\r\n          () => reject(new Error(timeoutCode)),\r\n          timeoutMs,\r\n        );\r\n      }),\r\n    ]);\r\n  } finally {\r\n    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction respFailure(\r\n  host: string,\r\n  port: number,\r\n  code: string,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n  received: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>,\r\n): HealthCheckResult {\r\n  const data: RespFailureData = {\r\n    ...listenerData(code, host, port, startedAt),\r\n    received: escapeRespBytes(received),\r\n  };\r\n  return {\r\n    status: HealthStatus.Unhealthy,\r\n    description:\r\n      `RESP listener unhealthy: ${code} at ${host}:${port} after ${data.elapsedMs} ms; received=\"${data.received}\"`,\r\n    data,\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction escapeRespBytes(bytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>): string {\r\n  const captured = bytes.subarray(0, RESP_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT_BYTES);\r\n  let escaped = '';\r\n  for (const byte of captured) {\r\n    switch (byte) {\r\n      case 0x0d:\r\n        escaped += '\\\\r';\r\n        break;\r\n      case 0x0a:\r\n        escaped += '\\\\n';\r\n        break;\r\n      case 0x5c:\r\n        escaped += '\\\\\\\\';\r\n        break;\r\n      default:\r\n        escaped += byte >= 0x20 && byte <= 0x7e\r\n          ? String.fromCharCode(byte)\r\n          : `\\\\x${byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0').toUpperCase()}`;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n  if (bytes.length > captured.length) {\r\n    escaped += `…(+${bytes.length - captured.length} bytes)`;\r\n  }\r\n  return escaped;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction listenerData(\r\n  code: string,\r\n  host: string,\r\n  port: number,\r\n  startedAt: number,\r\n): ListenerFailureData {\r\n  return {\r\n    code,\r\n    host,\r\n    port: String(port),\r\n    elapsedMs: String(Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt)),\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction normalizeListenerPort(port: number | string): number {\r\n  return typeof port === 'number' ? port : Number.parseInt(port, 10);\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction socketErrorCode(error: Error): string {\r\n  const code = Reflect.get(error, 'code');\r\n  return typeof code === 'string' ? code : 'UNKNOWN';\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Path helpers\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\nexport function resolveWorkspacePath(\r\n  appHostDir: string,\r\n  relativePath: string,\r\n): string {\r\n  return resolve(appHostDir, relativePath);\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function resolveDataPath(\r\n  appHostDir: string,\r\n  dataPath: string | undefined,\r\n  resourceName: string,\r\n): string {\r\n  const relativePath = dataPath ?? join('.data', resourceName);\r\n  return resolveWorkspacePath(appHostDir, relativePath);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Returns one project-scoped database password for the resident AppHost graph.\r\n */\r\nexport function ensureDatabasePassword(appHostDir: string, resourceName: string): string {\r\n  const secretsDir = resolveWorkspacePath(appHostDir, join('.data', 'aspire-secrets'));\r\n  const passwordPath = join(secretsDir, `${resourceName}.password`);\r\n  mkdirSync(secretsDir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });\r\n\r\n  if (!existsSync(passwordPath)) {\r\n    const password = crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '');\r\n    try {\r\n      writeFileSync(passwordPath, password, { encoding: 'utf8', flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      if (!(error instanceof Error) || !('code' in error) || error.code !== 'EEXIST') throw error;\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const password = readFileSync(passwordPath, 'utf8').trim();\r\n  if (!password) throw new Error(`Database password file is empty: ${passwordPath}`);\r\n  return password;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Database environment helpers\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\nexport function buildDatabaseUriEnvKey(\r\n  config: Pick<NetScriptConfig, 'PrimaryDatabase'>,\r\n): string | null {\r\n  if (!config.PrimaryDatabase) {\r\n    return null;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const prefix = config.PrimaryDatabase\r\n    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_')\r\n    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')\r\n    .toUpperCase();\r\n  return prefix ? `${prefix}_URI` : null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function buildDatabaseProviderEnvVars(\r\n  config: Pick<NetScriptConfig, 'PrimaryDatabase'>,\r\n): Record<string, string> {\r\n  if (!config.PrimaryDatabase) return {};\r\n  return {\r\n    DB_PROVIDER: config.PrimaryDatabase,\r\n    DATABASE_PROVIDER: config.PrimaryDatabase,\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function buildSqliteDatabaseUrl(\r\n  appHostDir: string,\r\n  databaseKey: string,\r\n  databaseName: string,\r\n): string {\r\n  return pathToFileURL(\r\n    resolveWorkspacePath(appHostDir, join('database', databaseKey, databaseName)),\r\n  ).href;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n// Permission resolution\r\n// ============================================================================\r\n\r\nexport function resolvePermissions(\r\n  entryPermissions: readonly string[] | undefined,\r\n  defaultPermissions: readonly string[],\r\n  watchMode: boolean = false,\r\n  watchFlag: string = RESOURCE_DEFAULTS.WatchHmrFlag,\r\n): string[] {\r\n  const base = entryPermissions ?   "// @generated from adapters/secrets/installation-secret-file.ts. process.env)[FILE_ENV];\n    if (explicit !== undefined) {\n      if (!explicit) throw new Error();\n      const file = resolve(explicit);\n      readSecret(file);\n      return file;\n    }\n    // Match ensureDatabasePassword: credentials travel with the git-ignored project data.\n    const directory = resolve(installationRoot, '.data', 'aspire-secrets');\n    mkdirSync(dirname(directory), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });\n    const data = lstatSync(dirname(directory));\n    if (!data.isDirectory() || data.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error();\n    mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });\n    assertOwnerOnly(directory, true);\n    const file = join(directory, 'installation.secret');\n    try {\n      lstatSync(file);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (!isMissing(error)) throw error;\n      // Publish a fully written file atomically. || permissions.includes('-A') || permissions.includes('--allow-all')\n  ) {\n    return [...permissions];\n  }\n  // Scoped Deno permission flags are comma-separated; carrier paths must not contain commas.\n  let result = [...permissions];\n  for (\n    const [flag, value] of [['--allow-read', file], ['--allow-env', FILE_ENV]]\n  ) {\n    if (result.includes(flag)) continue;\n    const prefix = `${flag}=`;\n    const scoped = result.filter((permission) => permission.startsWith(prefix));\n    result = result.filter((permission) => !permission.startsWith(prefix));\n    result.push(\n      `${prefix}${\n        [\n          ...scoped.flatMap((permission) => permission.slice(prefix.length).split(',')),\n          value,\n        ].join(',')\n      }`,\n    );\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\nfunction readSecret(file: string): string {\n  assertOwnerOnly(dirname(file), true);\n  assertOwnerOnly(file, false);\n  const descriptor = openSync(\n    file,\n    constants.O_RDONLY | (constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0),\n  );\n  try {\n    const metadata = fstatSync(descriptor);\n    if (!metadata.isFile() || metadata.size > MAX_BYTES) throw new Error();\n    const buffer = new && error.code === 'ENOENT';\n}\n\nfunction isExists(error: unknown): boolean {\n  return error instanceof Error && 'code' in error && error.code === 'EEXIST';\n}\n";
const template_048 =
  "// run-tool.mts — GENERATED BY @netscript/cli. detail: truncateUtf8(detail, MAX_ACTIONABLE_STDERR_LINE_BYTES),\r\n      sequence: captureSequence++,\r\n    };\r\n    if (head.length < ACTIONABLE_STDERR_HEAD_LINES) {\r\n      head.push(retained);\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (tail.length === ACTIONABLE_STDERR_TAIL_LINES) tail.shift();\r\n    tail.push(retained);\r\n  }\r\n  function captureActionableLines(flush = '' : lines.pop() ?? '' : lines.pop() ?? '';\r\n    for (const line of lines) {\r\n      const detail = stripVTControlCharacters(line).trim();\r\n      if (!detail || detail.startsWith('Task ')) continue;\r\n      retainActionableLine(detail, actionableStdoutHead, actionableStdoutTail);\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n  const captureStdout = (async () => {\r\n    const stdoutDecoder = new TextDecoder();\r\n    for await (const chunk of child.stdout) {\r\n      await Deno.stdout.write(chunk);\r\n      stdoutBuffer += stdoutDecoder.decode(chunk, { stream: true });\r\n      captureActionableStdoutLines();\r\n    }\r\n    stdoutBuffer += stdoutDecoder.decode();\r\n    stdoutBuffer += '\\n';\r\n    captureActionableStdoutLines(true);\r\n  })();\r\n\r\n  const timeoutId = options.timeoutSeconds === undefined ? `deno task ${taskName} timed out after ${options.timeoutSeconds} seconds`\r\n    : success\r\n    ? `deno task ${taskName} completed successfully`\r\n    : selectFailureMessage(\r\n      diagnostics.chronological.map((line) => line.detail),\r\n      fallbackFailureMessage,\r\n    );\r\n  if (!success && options.errorFile) {\r\n    await Deno.writeTextFile(\r\n      options.errorFile,\r\n      timedOut || actionableStderr.length + actionableStdout.length === 0\r\n        ? message\r\n        : [...actionableStderr, ...actionableStdout].join('\\n'),\r\n    );\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return { success, message, exitCode: status.code, actionableStderr, actionableStdout };\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction selectFailureMessage(lines: readonly string[], fallback: string): string {\r\n  return lines.find((line) => FAILURE_MESSAGE_SHAPE.test(line)) ??   "<!-- netscript-agent:start -->\r\n## NetScript build and tooling map\r\n\r\n### Build in the framework's order\r\n\r\nUse the architectural spine: database-derived schemas → contract → service → typed SDK and query factories → `definePage` composition → islands. The app build guide at `apps/<app>/AGENTS.md` explains the local examples and the project's `definePage`, `withResource`, and `withForm` composition conventions; read it before app work instead of inventing a parallel pattern, and use MCP `find_guidance` or the installed offline docs for `defineRouteContract`, `staleTime`, dehydration, and optimistic UI.\r\n\r\nUse the CLI for mutations: `netscript contract`, `netscript service`, `netscript db`, and `netscript generate`. Create UI through `netscript ui:add page <path> --island`, `netscript ui:add island <Name> --query`, or `netscript ui:add data-table` rather than hand-building generated seams.\r\n\r\n### Inspect Deno before implementing\r\n\r\nThe canonical primer is <https://deno.com/agents.md>. Its setup prompt is: \"Read https://deno.com/agents.md and set up Deno in this project.\"\r\n\r\nUse `deno doc <module>` or `deno doc --filter <symbol> <module>` to learn a package's public API, `deno info` to inspect the resolved graph, and `deno eval` for a quick behavioural probe. These come before reading package source over HTTP. For dependency work, use `deno outdated`, `deno why`, and `deno add` instead of hand-editing imports.\r\n\r\nRun the workspace quality verbs it defines: `deno task check`, `deno task test`, `deno task lint`, and `deno task fmt:check`. A run is not finished until `deno task test` has run. For the deeper command map, call the `deno` skill; this file only points to it.\r\n\r\n### MCP is the default surface\r\n\r\nMCP is the default surface for NetScript work, not one option among several: NetScript is newer than your training data, so without the `netscript` MCP tools you will reimplement contracts, services, SDK clients, and UI seams the CLI already generates. Before implementing an unfamiliar NetScript API or architecture, call MCP `find_guidance` with the task. Use `search_docs` for literal lookup and `get_doc` for faithful retrieval. Check its `mode`; for complete text use `full: true` and follow `nextCursor` with `cursor` until absent. Use MCP `doctor` for NetScript, Aspire, project-wiring, and plugin prerequisites; use `get_app_status`, `get_recent_errors`, and the `analyze_*` tools for bounded runtime evidence.{{OFFLINE_DOCS_GUIDANCE}}\r\n\r\nIf no `netscript` MCP tools are listed, stop and recover before writing framework code:\r\n\r\n1. If the `netscript` MCP server is up, call MCP `doctor`. If it is not, run `netscript plugin doctor` from the shell; there is no bare `netscript doctor`.\r\n2. Re-run `netscript agent init --host <host>` for your agent host (`claude`, `vscode`, or `opencode`), then restart the host so it reloads its MCP configuration.\r\n\r\nBefore hand-rolled curl probes or print debugging, run `netscript plugin doctor`, `aspire doctor --format Json`, `aspire logs`, and `aspire otel logs`, `aspire otel spans`, or `aspire otel traces`. Drift is evidence-gated: `netscript agent drift record` and MCP `record_drift` require a recent successful diagnostic receipt. Receipts live under `.netscript/agent/diagnostics/`; accepted entries append to `.netscript/agent/drift.jsonl`.\r\n\r\n### Invoke the right installed skill\r\n\r\nSkills are addressed by their registered name. Call the skill by name and its body, with its bundled references, loads on demand. Hosts that register these names use their skill tool. On Claude Code, call the `repo-skills` bridge with the requested skill name; the bridge permits loading its canonical file and bundled references.\r\n\r\n- Call the `netscript` skill to route an unfamiliar NetScript task.\r\n- Call the `netscript-build` skill before scaffolding, adding, or generating contracts, services, database assets, plugins, or UI.\r\n- Call the `netscript-operate` skill for health, failures, recent runs, documentation lookup, and performance evidence.\r\n- Call the `aspire` skill for AppHost lifecycle, resources, dashboards, logs, spans, and traces.\r\n- Call the installed `aspire-init`, `aspire-orchestration`, `aspire-monitoring`, `aspire-deployment`, and `aspireify` workflow skills for their named lifecycle phases; NetScript's `aspire` skill remains the diagnostic authority.\r\n- Call the `deno` skill for Deno runtime, types, permissions, dependencies, or module resolution.\r\n- If something hangs, vanishes, stays silent, or is Healthy but does not respond, start at the `.agents/skills/help.md` playbook.\r\n<!-- netscript-agent:end -->\r\n";
